levels.name: Rushing Hound: Swift as the Wind
levels.description: When characters (other than Gorou) within the AoE of Gorou's General's War Banner or General's Glory deal Geo DMG to opponents, the CD of Gorou's Inuzaka All-Round Defense is decreased by 2s. This effect can occur once every 10s.

levels.name: Sitting Hound: Steady as a Clock
levels.description: While General's Glory is in effect, its duration is extended by 1s when a nearby active character obtains an Elemental Shard from a Crystallize reaction. This effect can occur once every 0.1s. Max extension is 3s.

levels.name: Mauling Hound: Fierce as Fire
levels.description: Increases the Level of Inuzaka All-Round Defense by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

levels.name: Lapping Hound: Warm as Water
levels.description: When General's Glory is in the "Impregnable" or "Crunch" states, it will also heal active characters within its AoE by 50% of Gorou's own DEF every 1.5s.

levels.name: Striking Hound: Thunderous Force
levels.description: Increases the Level of Juuga: Forward Unto Victory by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

levels.name: Valiant Hound: Mountainous Fealty
levels.description: For 12s after using Inuzaka All-Round Defense or Juuga: Forward Unto Victory, increases the CRIT DMG of all nearby party members' Geo DMG based on the buff level of the skill's field at the time of use: "Standing Firm": +10% "Impregnable": +20% "Crunch": +40% This effect cannot stack and will take reference from the last instance of the effect that is triggered.
